games.name: Ambulads
games.description: Rescue accident victims in a physics-based co-op game where your patient’s health determines your payday. Expand your ambulance, improvise with absurd tools and sell loot on the side.

games.name: Totally Legal Logging
games.description: A co-op physics comedy about a crew of dwarves running a totally legal logging business. Fell trees with real physics, feed them to questionable machines, load the truck and get out before the forester arrives. Your friends are also a resource.

games.name: Fogblower
games.description: Fogblower is an incremental game. Clear the fog with the fan on your little boat, discover treasures and strange creatures of the deep, and upgrade your boat until one day you can reach the mainland and earn your freedom.

games.name: DON’T CAMP ON BEAR ISLAND
games.description: DON'T CAMP ON BEAR ISLAND! JUST DON'T DO IT! Stranded with 1-3 friends in online co-op, you have to haul your scattered gear up the mountain and build camp. The tent is heavy, nobody agrees which way is left, and something out there is listening.

games.name: Hold Your Position
games.description: An incremental-style tower defense game where you face waves of orcs, undead, and demons. Recruit more troops, buy and upgrade skills, obtain powerful spells, and hold your position.

games.name: Food Fight Online
games.description: Join a team of food and wage war on a giant kitchen counter. Rev up, let go and splat your enemies with throws, or capture regions to take over the map. Pineapples, watermelons and more battle online in chaotic deathmatch and capture modes. Last team splatting wins!

games.name: Who is the Thief?
games.description: Runners hide in a crowd of identical NPCs. Hunters spot the one who moves like a human. An asymmetric online party game for 2–10 players: finish your tasks without getting caught, or hunt down the runners hiding in the crowd.

games.name: MOMENT: A Clockwork Melody
games.description: Solve puzzles as you compose melodies. Place clockwork launchers, tune their timing and guide balls through colour-changing routes. Each collision plays a note, turning your solution into music. Explore 40 levels, experiment in Free Mode and share your own puzzles.

games.name: Slice the Mountain
games.description: A relaxing incremental game about a red panda girl who wants to slice a mountain.

games.name: FLESHBAG
games.description: FLESHBAG is a 3D physics sandbox about one very unlucky guy. He has organs, a brain, a face and a voice, and he has opinions about your machines. Build him a mixer, crusher or a cozy cabin. He will complain about all of them.

games.name: Infinite Crosswalk
games.description: Infinite Crosswalk is a psychedelic walking simulator and horror game in retro 3D style. You get hit on a zebra crossing and trapped in limbo. Uncover the victims' tragic stories to escape — or pay with parts of your own body.

games.name: Prospects
games.description: Strip the solar system of its bountiful resources, all for the betterment of mankind - and your corporation's bottom line. Build and command your fleet of industrial vessels, establish manufacturing outposts, and seek out the richest prospects to expand your mining empire.

games.name: Minotaur Hotel
games.description: A mythology-inspired gay visual novel about the legendary Minotaur. Manage a magical hotel, explore the stories of mythical beings from around the world, and uncover the realm's dark history.

games.name: Marble Hoarder
games.description: Sort thousands of glass marbles in a cozy, messy old marble shop. Pick them up, toss each one into the tray where it belongs, unlock skills like Spotlight, Gather and Auto-Place, and race your marbles on a wooden race machine. No timers, no pressure.

games.name: Desktop Divinity
games.description: Build a cozy idle kingdom at the bottom of your desktop. Recruit female followers, collect gold and faith, and summon goddesses. Watch your pixel companions stroll, dance, and pray while you grow your realm and upgrade its facilities.

games.name: Crack the Stone
games.description: Minimalist desktop idle game that lives in the corner of your screen. Upgrade the water flow from a single drop to a steady stream and keep wearing the stone down. Someday it will crack. Patience always wins.

games.name: Retro Party
games.description: Nostalgia for '90s games: 25+ mini-games in a single party. Play online with up to 8 people, or 4 on the same screen. Every game is its own kind of chaos: racing, shooting, a battle of wills, and plenty more. A chance to relive the good old days with your friends.

games.name: Anomaly Watch: Rainy Night
games.description: A rainy night, an empty house and a row of security cameras. Watch the rooms, notice what has changed and report it before the anomalies pile up.

games.name: Anomaly Watch: Mine
games.description: You watch an old mine through security cameras. Check the tunnels and the work areas, find what has changed and report it before the anomalies pile up.

games.name: Othercrown
games.description: A deck-building auto-battler roguelite where you build your own slot machine to deploy monsters and cast spells against the human kingdoms. Mutate your creatures, and maximize your slots to deploy as many creatures and spells as you can during your fights against the human kingdoms.

games.name: Star Ring Convenience Store
games.description: A supernatural adventure about working for a living and getting stuck in a time loop. On her first day on the job, intern Amo is trapped in the same day. Meet eccentric late-night customers, connect clues in your Mind Palace, and uncover the secrets hidden inside Star Ring Convenience Store.

games.name: Good Boy Good Waves
games.description: Set out on a relaxing paddleboard journey across scenic island waters with your faithful canine companion. Catch the rhythm of gentle waves, balance your board, explore peaceful coastlines, and uncover tranquil island secrets together.

games.name: Panzertanken
games.description: Turn-based tank artillery on fully destructible pixel terrain. Command about 200 tanks from WWI to today, dig in with shovels and steel plates, and blow up enemy bunkers in five campaigns, 3 vs 3 battles against bots, hot-seat duels and online matches.

games.name: The Bastion Protocol
games.description: The Bastion Protocol is an idle tower defense game where a lone tower faces relentless enemy waves. Earn Entropy from kills, strengthen your build, and survive until your tower falls. Turn each run’s rewards into lasting upgrades and return stronger.

games.name: Optiminer
games.description: Optiminer is a minimalist incremental about mining radioactive materials. Dig through the rock to extract raw ore and radioactive materials, then pour it all into a branching upgrade tree and go deeper.

games.name: Eggcellent Guess
games.description: A silly online party game for up to 12 friends. Everyone can read the word on your egg's headband except you. Ask questions, listen to the clues and guess it before the stopwatch gets away from you. Fastest total time wins.

games.name: Retail Empire
games.description: Design, build, and manage a supermarket where store layout controls what shoppers see and buy. Use customer sightlines and smart display placement to trigger impulse buys, control eye-level shelf space across 250+ products, create your own store-brand products, and maximize your profits!

games.name: Excabyte
games.description: Excabyte is an incremental mining game where you start with a single miner and build your own mining empire. Extract valuable resources, purchase powerful machinery and avoid disasters.

games.name: Meowside: Desktop Cats
games.description: Adorable pixel cats live on your screen. Watch them eat, nap, and wander through daily routines. Pet them or play with a cat wand, and enjoy their company every day.

games.name: こもれびの丘
games.description: I accidentally overslept on the train and ended up in some kind of mysterious towns. This is a relaxing, slow-life game where you wander around the streets freely, meet the locals, and feel the changing seasons together with the main character, Rifa, who unexpectedly became the town's representative

games.name: Mostly Absurd Battle Simulator
games.description: Wobbly physics battles. Place an army of farmers, knights, giants and a train with a face, press Launch and watch it all fall apart. Grab anyone and throw them off a cliff, or jump into a soldier and fight yourself.

games.name: Drawbacks: Draw, Guess, Sabotage
games.description: The draw-and-guess party game where your friends fight dirty. While you draw, they spend ink on sabotage cards that shake, flip, mirror and splatter your doodle. Guess fast, sabotage smart and laugh at the wreckage. 2–16 players online.

games.name: Pack Party
games.description: The drawing party game where you and your friends make a deck of absurd cards to answer ridiculous prompts. 4 to 10 players.

games.name: Depthline
games.description: Go 18 floors down a quarantined building. Pick the room, watch your survivor gun down the zombies and grab the gear they drop. Merge twins into rarer items, stack class bonuses and build a loadout that can reach Patient Zero. An inventory-management roguelite where the build wins the fight.

games.name: Bloom & Broom
games.description: Clean up an overgrown plot, turn the junk into blocks with your machine and sell them to passing customers. Upgrade your tools, find cards hidden all over the place and unlock new areas. This is just a cozy game.

games.name: SimFarm
games.description: A 3D farm management game where crops grow with the weather and the soil. Choose how tight money gets: play relaxed, or face real costs, loans and the risk of going broke. You give the orders; tractors and harvesters do the work. Rotate cows, sheep and horses through paddocks.

games.name: Egg Harvest
games.description: Egg Harvest is a roguelike farming game where you try to save your farm from debt. Produce eggs with your chickens, complete contracts, choose powerful upgrades, and fill your egg catalog. Keep producing until your debt is paid off!

games.name: Bouture
games.description: Potted plants that live on your Windows desktop. They grow over days and weeks, droop when you forget them, and flower if you keep watering. Double-click a plant to water it.

games.name: Railtown
games.description: Every great city starts with a station. In Railtown, trains bring tourists and money while you grow a tiny town into a bustling city: build homes, shops and tram lines, upgrade your train from steam to high-speed, and keep your citizens happy through every season.

games.name: Leif's Garden Tower
games.description: Grow plants, tend the greenhouse, and fall in love with the customers of Leif's Garden Tower. Leif's Garden Tower is a cozy 2D tower-builder about a lonely leaf spirit rebuilding an abandoned greenhouse, help him restore the tower and learn its secrets.

games.name: Dump Chaos
games.description: Dig through piles of junk, place the items you find on their proper shelves, and sell them to make money. Take your time organizing, add rare finds to your collection, and enjoy the satisfying feeling of turning chaos into order.

games.name: Card Dice
games.description: An idle progression game with a casino dice theme. Let your card dice roll automatically and beat opponents in timed matches. Collect gems and engravings to create different builds, trade up your equipment, and advance to higher-level tables.

games.name: Meteor Shower
games.description: Blast away never-ending hordes of falling meteors in this incremental tower defense game! Smash rocks to pieces with railguns, flak cannons, giant lasers and more as you work to defend your base from the stellar onslaught.

games.name: Mini Pond Farm: Frogs & Lilypads
games.description: Collect all the cute frogs! Shape your pond paradise, fill it with colorful hoppers, make them happy with reeds and lilies, and enjoy pure cozy serenity.

games.name: Ium Idle Companions Odyssey
games.description: Monster-collecting auto-battler desktop companion. Assemble, customize, strategize elemental synergies, craft powerful skill loadouts, and conquer regions as your squad fights autonomously in fast-paced real-time combat at the edge of your screen while you work, study, or play.

games.name: Anomaly Watch: Castle
games.description: You are the night watch of an old castle. Look through the cameras in its halls and cellars, find what has changed and report it before the anomalies take the castle.

games.name: Anomaly Watch: Catacombs
games.description: You watch the catacombs through security cameras. Check the tunnels and chambers, find what has changed and report it before the anomalies pile up.

games.name: Anomaly Watch: Polar Station
games.description: You work a night shift at a polar station. Switch between the cameras, notice what has changed and report it. Make too many mistakes, or let too many anomalies pile up, and the shift is over.

games.name: Unhistorical Warfare
games.description: Command 30+ historical armies across 3,000 years of warfare, from Persian spearmen to Abrams tanks, in real-time pixel-art battles where every soldier fights and flees on his own. Then deploy the anomalies: trolls, zombies, wizards, flying saucers and more!

games.name: Proviantmeister 1756
games.description: His Majesty’s army shall march – provided you keep it supplied! Manage depots, organize wagon trains, procure provisions, fodder and ammunition, and contend with weather and war. A historical military logistics simulation set during the Seven Years’ War, 1756–1763.

games.name: Gotta Catch Bugs!
games.description: Gotta Catch Bugs! is a cozy first-person bug-catching game. A mutant plant has overgrown an underground lab and broken the control panel - 5,000 mutant insects are on the loose. Catch them with a net and jar, return all 500 species to their terrariums and unlock their powers!

games.name: Catch the Button
games.description: Make aim practice fun! Warm up before your next match, sharpen your reflexes, improve your mouse accuracy and enjoy chaotic arcade challenges. Train your aim while having fun!

games.name: CRUMBKINS
games.description: A 1–4 player physics-based co-op heist comedy about tiny, hungry thieves. Climb giant furniture, steal food for picky clients, and decide: deliver the loot, throw it to a friend, or eat a pepper and shoot fireballs.

games.name: Chalk Thrower Simulator
games.description: Keep a sleepy class awake by throwing chalk then a duster to finish. Draft perks between periods, climb twelve Standards, outlast Detention, race the Daily or crack 32 chalk puzzles. Solo, online co-op or versus.

games.name: DeepSeaFishery
games.description: A deep-sea idle fishing game. Cast, let your fish grow and your crew work while you are away. Descend from the shallows to coral reefs, polar ice and volcanic vents, collecting 252 species. Hire helpers, upgrade your gear, then retire to trade the run for permanent talents.

games.name: Fine Tuning: A Radio Repair Shop
games.description: Run a little radio repair shop in 1952, where every wireless on your bench is a working circuit, so the meter reads what's really there and the hum or the crackle you hear is the fault itself. You take each set apart by hand and fit new parts from the cabinet till it plays again for its owner.

games.name: No Sleep Tonight
games.description: No Sleep Tonight is an incremental game about counting sheep and late-night inspiration. You keep trying to fall asleep, only to get back up to jot down another idea. Your eyelids grow heavier, but the workshop in your head only gets busier…

games.name: YinShu
games.description: Played The Message? YinShu is a free online social deduction card game inspired by it, for 4–8 players. Everyone hides a faction and passes intel; read friend from foe in who accepts and who refuses. Intercept, see through and swap intel with character skills. Collect three of your color to win.

games.name: Baggage Belt
games.description: Grow a tiny pixel-art airport all the way to the stars in this cozy idle game. Check in bags, hire the crew and book routes that multiply your income. Every airport has its own minigame, and the belt keeps running while you're away. Your crew chief is a corgi called Biscuit.

games.name: Tidal Life
games.description: Tidal Life is a first person open world exploration game. On this vast and boundless island, you must survive through diving, fishing, and beachcombing. Use the resources you gather to upgrade your equipment, complete the illustrated guide, enrich your island. collect or defeat them all !
